meta.note: One places dataset for the Vigliotti Heritage map and for any exported map. Living people are not placed on the map. Town points use a halo; known buildings use a pin. Coordinates are from OpenStreetMap Nominatim, 26 November 2026. Italian towns use the town centre; exact houses on Via Rusciano and via Maddalena are not pinned.
notYetOnTheMap: The exact houses at Via Rusciano 23, Santa Maria a Vico, and via Maddalena 2, Arienzo, are not pinned; the map uses the town centres.
A cousin in Newburgh, New York, is named on the 1903 Roma manifest, but the reading is uncertain and is not yet a map event.
Owen Cleary and Catherine Donohue are named in Catherine Hingston's 1932 obituary and are not yet added as people on the tree.
The town where Pat and Susan married on 30 October 1977 is not named in the obituary.
Patricia Morrisey Walsh's burial place is not yet known.
Current or recent homes of living people are held back, including a 2019 residence named in the Walsh obituary.

Margaret Farrell's reported burial at Saint Joseph's Cemetery, Yonkers, after her death on 5 November 1873, is not pinned. That cemetery was purchased in 1877, so the original burial place is still an open question, and the stone has not been photographed.

Later Farrell descendants named only in the compiled family letter, and the three daughters mentioned but not named in the swearing-in clipping of Justice William A. Walsh Jr., are not added to the tree or the map.

places.name: Santa Maria a Vico, Caserta, Campania, Italy
places.historicName: Santa Maria a Vico, Caserta, Campania
places.coordinateMethod: Point from OpenStreetMap Nominatim, looked up on 26 November 2026.
places.blurb: A Campanian town near Naples, and the birthplace of Vincenzo Vigliotti, confirmed by his 1885 civil birth act. His parents, Andrea Vigliotti and Mariantonia Ruotolo, married in the town hall in February 1883. Andrea was probably born on the same street, Strada Rusciano, in 1853, and Mariantonia was probably born there in 1856.

events.summary: Vincenzo Vigliotti was born here at 11 at night on 4 July 1885, at Via Rusciano 23.
events.note: The house number and street are from the birth act. The pin is the town centre, not the exact house.

events.summary: Andrea Vigliotti was probably born here on 30 November 1853, on Strada Rusciano, and baptised the same day at Sant'Andrea Apostolo.
events.note: The 1853 act is confirmed. Linking that child to Vincenzo's father is probable: the 1883 marriage names the same parents, but the groom's stated age of 35 conflicts with 1853.

events.summary: Andrea Vigliotti and Mariantonia Ruotolo were married here on 18 February 1883, a date whose day is a careful reading, in the town hall.
events.note: The year and the month February are clear. The day is read as the 18th; the word Diciotto is uncertain, so the day is flagged. The pin is the town centre, not the exact building.

events.summary: Andrea Vigliotti and Mariantonia Ruotolo were living at Via Rusciano 23 when they registered Vincenzo's birth.
Mariantonia Ruotolo was probably born here on 28 June 1856, on Strada Rusciano.
events.note: The 1856 act is confirmed. Linking that child to Vincenzo's mother is probable, because the 1883 marriage names the same parents and an age that fits.
